info.title: Harvester of Sorrow API
info.description:
REST API for Harvester of Sorrow — a video downloader supporting VixSrc and RaiPlay sources.

**Key features:**
- Search movies and TV shows across multiple sources
- Queue, monitor, cancel and retry downloads
- Real-time progress updates via Server-Sent Events
- TV show library scanning and automatic episode monitoring

**Notes:**
- No authentication is required
- VixSrc availability checks use the Italian (`it`) catalogue
- Live updates: `GET /api/v1/events` (`text/event-stream`)
- Errors are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json`

put.summary: Change a monitored show's source match

post.description: Queues episodes newer than the latest one on disk. Returns how many were queued.
Expands shows and seasons server-side and returns every task created.

delete.description: Removes completed, failed, cancelled and not-found tasks. Files on disk are kept.

post.description: Allowed for FAILED and CANCELLED tasks.

409.description: Task is not failed or cancelled

post.description: Allowed in any non-terminal state, including QUEUED.

post.summary: Episodes really available on the source
post.description: VixSrc: TMDB episodes filtered by the VixSrc catalogue (falls back to TMDB when the catalogue is unavailable). RaiPlay: the program's episode listings. Each episode has its own sourceRef.

get.summary: Runtime information and free disk space of the download paths
Enabled sources, their languages, and download defaults

get.description: Change via environment variables and restart.
Searches every enabled source in parallel. VixSrc results are filtered by real availability.

Every folder under DOWNLOAD_TV_SHOWS_PATH plus monitored shows whose folder is gone, with on-disk season/episode counts, monitoring config and TMDB airing status (folders without a TMDB id are matched by name).

Named events, each `data` is JSON:
- `snapshot`: array of all tasks, sent first on every (re)connect
- `task.created`, `task.updated`, `task.removed`: one full task
A `:heartbeat` comment is sent about every 15 s. Updates are throttled to ~4/s per task;
terminal states are sent immediately. Clients should replace their state on `snapshot`
and upsert/delete by id on the others.

MonitoredShowRequest.description: Create or update a monitored show. `directoryName` is ignored on update.

MonitoredShowDto.description: A show directory linked to a source for automatic new-episode downloads

ToolCheckDto.description: Result of probing an external tool

quality.description: best, 1080, 720 or worst; empty = server default

SubTaskDto.description: One track (video, audio or subtitle) of a download task

TaskDto.description: A download task with its tracks

EpisodesRequest.description: Which show (and optionally which season) to list episodes for

EpisodeDto.description: An episode that is really available on the source

DiskDto.description: Disk usage of a configured download path

languages.description: Audio languages the source serves; empty = no restriction

items.description: Audio languages the source serves; empty = no restriction

tmdbApiKeyMasked.description: Masked TMDB key, e.g. `••••••••3f9a`; null when unset

SettingsDto.description: Read-only configuration (change via environment variables and restart)

externalUrl.description: Public page of the title (TMDB or RaiPlay)

sourceRef.description: Opaque source reference; pass back unchanged to /content/episodes and /downloads

SeasonDto.description: A season of a TV show as known at search time

directoryExists.description: False when a monitored show's folder is gone

completed.description: True when TMDB reports the show as Ended or Canceled. Completed monitored shows are skipped by scheduled checks.

showStatus.description: TMDB show status (e.g. "Returning Series", "Ended"); null when unknown (TMDB not configured or no match)

LibraryEntryDto.description: A show folder on disk, with its monitoring config if any
